verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for financial-infrastructure platforms, since some core-banking and ledger products ship on-prem or self-managed deployments, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Unit offering a self-hostable or on-premises deployment of its core platform. Every item describes a vendor-operated, hosted service: APIs, the Dashboard, partner-bank connectivity, and 'Fully managed by Unit' Managed Solutions.
